home.title: Karibu {{app}}
home.tagline: Jumuiya moja ya kurudi nyumbani na kuwa na afya.

area.comingSoon: Inakuja hivi karibuni. Eneo hili ni kishikilia nafasi tu.

wellbeing.roughHelp: You are not alone. The crisis button above is always here — call or text 988, or 911 in an emergency.
wellbeing.locksHelp: Funga kipengele kwa wiki moja, wiki mbili, mwezi mmoja au kabisa. Kitufe cha dharura, msaada wa kurudia, mawasiliano salama na kufuta data havifungwi kamwe.

community.noPhone: Nambari za simu hazionyeshwi kamwe kwenye ujumbe wa rika.

support.resourcesNote: Legal aid, treatment and transit. This directory does not cover food or housing.
support.meetingsTitle: Mikutano ya hatua kumi na mbili na uponaji

safety.relapseDraft: Draft — for review. Calm first steps for the first 24 hours after a slip will appear here once reviewed. You are not alone.
safety.safeContactsHelp: Weka mdhamini wako au mawasiliano salama umbali wa mguso mmoja.
safety.vaultHelp: Your documents are encrypted. Paid plan feature; no price has been set yet.
safety.wipeHelp: Hii inafuta data yako kweli wala hairudishwi.
safety.wipeConfirm: Naelewa hii inafuta data yangu kweli.

reentry.tipsAnonymous: Vidokezo havina majina. Nambari za simu hazionyeshwi kamwe.
reentry.celebrationFirst: Hatua ya kwanza imekamilika — karibu nyumbani.
reentry.celebrationAll: Hatua zote 33 zimekamilika. Sherehekea maendeleo yako.
reentry.crisisStep: Hifadhi nambari hizi sasa. Unaweza pia kugusa Need help now juu ya skrini yoyote.
reentry.resourceOnly: Kiashiria cha rasilimali tu — Groundwork haitoi hii wala haishirikiani na watoa huduma.

steps.step2: Omba kadi yako ya Usalama wa Jamii
steps.step3: Anza ombi la kitambulisho cha jimbo
steps.step4: Weka malengo na meneja wa kesi yako
steps.step7: Find a safe place to stay (call 211 or local housing resources)
steps.step8: Find food for this week (call 211 or a local food pantry)
steps.step9: Kagua karatasi zako za kuachiwa na tarehe za mwisho
steps.step10: Thibitisha tarehe ya kwanza ya check-in na masharti
steps.step13: Pata simu, barua pepe na intaneti ya bure
steps.step14: Put every court date and check-in on a calendar
steps.step15: Wasiliana na huduma za kurejea za mitaa
steps.step17: Check your fines, fees and restitution
steps.step18: Angalia hali ya leseni yako ya udereva
steps.step19: Enroll in Medicaid, and SNAP if you need it
steps.step23: Weka miadi ya afya ya akili
steps.step24: Fanya tathmini ya matumizi ya dawa za kulevya
steps.step27: Omba kwa waajiri wa nafasi ya pili
steps.step29: Fungua akaunti ya benki na tengeneza bajeti
steps.step31: Ungana tena na familia yako, na shughulikia malezi ya watoto ikihitajika
steps.step33: Weka lengo la muda mrefu na sherehekea siku zako 90

work.paroleNote: Check your parole or probation conditions with your officer before applying.

journey.portfolioPrivate: Ya faragha kwa chaguo-msingi. Shiriki unapoamua tu.

venue.placeholder: Sehemu ya muda — chumba kijivu. Hakuna picha halisi za ukumbi zilizotolewa; huu si ukumbi halisi.

readAloud.title: Kusoma kwa sauti
readAloud.help: Kusoma kwa sauti hutumia sauti ya kifaa chako kusoma maandishi.

phase3.resumeHelp: Tengeneza wasifu wa maandishi wazi kutokana na uzoefu wako.
phase3.headline: Kichwa
phase3.interviewHelp: Fanya mazoezi ya majibu. Kocha wako anakupa alama na kidokezo.
phase3.gigsHelp: Short local jobs. Check parole conditions with your officer. Phone numbers are never shown.
phase3.paidNote: Paid plan. No price has been set yet.
phase3.geoHelp: Jiji lako tu ndilo wengine wanaona. Mahali kamili hakishirikiwi kamwe.
phase3.rideHelp: Omba lifti. Nambari za simu hazionyeshwi kamwe. Kutana mahali pa umma.
phase3.caption: Maelezo
phase3.qaHelp: Uliza bila jina. Wanachama walio mbele wanajibu.
phase3.merchHelp: Alama za msimbo tu. Hakuna nje inayoeleza maana yake, wala tarehe zilizochapishwa.
phase3.shareHelp: Kadi yenye nambari za maendeleo yako.
phase3.archiveHelp: Funga ujumbe kwako. Hufunguka siku ya hatua.
phase3.matchHelp: Ajenti yako huzungumza na majenti mengine kwanza. Kuchumbiana kumezimwa kwa sasa. Unaweza kuona kwa nini, omba utambulisho na ujaribu tena.
phase3.datingOff: Kuchumbiana kumezimwa hadi kanuni ya siku za chini iwekwe.
phase3.carpoolHelp: Mahali pa kwanza pa kuangalia. Hiari, ngazi ya jiji tu: ona nani anaelekea mkutanoni kwako na unganisha kupitia ujumbe wa programu. Hakuna simu, hakuna mahali kamili.
phase3.groupsHelp: Vikundi vya uponaji, kurejea, imani na jumuiya kwa jiji na wakati wa mkutano. Data ya sampuli tu — si orodha halisi.
phase3.rideFallbackHelp: Inaonyeshwa tu wakati hakuna mtu kwenye bodi ya carpool anaelekea mkutanoni kwako. Huchapisha ombi lililodhibitiwa kwenye programu — ngazi ya jiji tu, hakuna simu.
phase3.noCarpoolMatch: Hakuna carpool kwa mkutano huu, kwa hivyo Nahitaji lifti inaonyeshwa kama mbadala.
phase3.familyRideHelp: Madereva walioidhinishwa tu. Arifa huenda moja baada ya nyingine na muda wa dakika 2; unathibitisha kabla ya kumuarifu anayefuata.
phase3.housingHelp: Savings goals plus a housing-readiness plan. Groundwork does not provide housing and does not partner with providers. For local help, call 211.
phase3.musicHelp: Nyimbo za sampuli tu. Hakuna akaunti za kutiririsha. Huzimwa ndani ya moduli za akademia na kozi.
phase3.musicOffAcademy: Muziki umezimwa ukiwa ndani ya moduli ya kozi.
phase3.shareWho: Sasa: wewe tu. Kuunda kiungo kunamruhusu mwenye kiungo kukisoma.
phase3.suggestHelp: Mapendekezo tu — hakuna kinachochapishwa hadi uongeze.

crisisReply.onlyYou: Wewe tu ndiye unayeweza kuona ujumbe huu.
crisisReply.openCrisis: Fungua kitufe cha dharura na mawasiliano salama
